key.name: global-model-scale-factor
key.description: Scale all the 3D models by this factor. (0.01 - 100)

key.name: model-filename
key.description: Full path to 3D wavefront (.obj) model file.

key.name: model-scale-factor
key.description: Scale the 3D model by this factor.

key.name: model-x-offset
key.description: X coordinate offset from the center of the cube.

key.name: model-y-offset
key.description: Y coordinate offset from the center of the cube.

key.name: model-z-offset
key.description: Z coordinate offset from the center of the cube.

key.name: model-rotation-plane
key.description: Plane of rotation for the 3D model.

key.name: model-rotation-rate
key.description: Rate of rotation of 3D model (in rotations per second).

key.name: model-fps
key.description: Framerate (per second) for the animated series of obj files.

key.name: rescale-width
key.description: Rescale along the sides of the cube by the ratio of screen width to height.

key.name: render-front-and-back
key.description: Renders the front surface and then the back surface. This can be useful for models which show black spots but can cause a performance hit.

key.name: rotate-lighting
key.description: Preserve light direction when rotating the cube.

key.name: light-inclination
key.description: The angle of light rays from the horizon in degrees (0 is from the viewer's perspective, 90 is from on top). Only has effect when Rotate Lighting is false. (0 - 180)

key.name: light-ambient
key.description: Component of light coming from all directions equally. (0.0 - 1.0)

key.name: light-diffuse
key.description: Component of light coming from the direction set by inclination or from the viewer if Rotate Lighting is true. (0.0 - 1.0)

key.name: light-specular
key.description: Highly directional component of light coming from the direction set by inclination or from the viewer if Rotate Lighting is true. (0.0 - 1.0)

key.name: concurrent-load
key.description: Use separate threads to load each model faster and allow other interaction whilst loading.
